name: Mathematics of Operations Research
description: Real and functional analysis: metric spaces, norms, closed and open sets, functions, limits, continuity, differentiation, Taylor's theorem, Weierstrass's theorem, sequences and series, integration, etc. Convex analysis: convex sets and convex functions, convex hull, duality, etc. Algorithms and data structures: operations count of algorithms, computational complexity, big-O notation, complexity classes, convergence of algorithms, data structures (stacks, heaps, queues, linked lists, etc.), and complexity of different operations on them, etc. Linear algebra: vector spaces, linear independence, basis, rank of matrices, system of linear equations, matrix norms, transformations and convolution, sparsity, algorithms for decomposition/inversion of sparse and dense matrices, etc.
